title: Projective-space bases of Lagrangian fibrations
summary: We prove that the normal projective base of a projective Lagrangian fibration from a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic Kähler manifold is projective space. This resolves the projective-space base conjecture for such fibrations in every dimension and deformation type.

review.reason: Proves the normal base of projective Lagrangian fibrations is projective space in all dimensions.
